title: Police Calls for Service
description: Police Calls for Service in Sandy City, Utah. The upstream service publishes no description for this layer. 185,647 point features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: evt_rin
table:columns.description: Dispatch record identifier.

table:columns.name: evt_reference
table:columns.description: Case reference number, which joins a call to an offence record in `crime-incidents` where one was written.

table:columns.name: jurisdiction
table:columns.description: Agency code for the responding jurisdiction.

table:columns.name: evt_date
table:columns.description: Date of the call.

table:columns.name: location
table:columns.description: Street address or place description of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 185,647 rows, 29,425 distinct values.

table:columns.name: zone
table:columns.description: Police zone the call falls in.

table:columns.name: grid
table:columns.description: Police reporting grid cell, joining to `police-reporting-areas`.

table:columns.name: week_day
table:columns.description: Day of week as a number.

table:columns.name: week_day_d
table:columns.description: Day of week as a name.

table:columns.name: received_dt
table:columns.description: Time dispatch received the call.

table:columns.name: dispatch_dt
table:columns.description: Time a unit was dispatched.

table:columns.name: enroute_dt
table:columns.description: Time the unit started travelling.

table:columns.name: at_scene_dt
table:columns.description: Time the unit arrived.

table:columns.name: clear_dt
table:columns.description: Time the unit cleared the call.

table:columns.name: case_type
table:columns.description: Initial call-type code assigned by the dispatcher.

table:columns.name: case_type_d
table:columns.description: Call type as first coded by the dispatcher.

table:columns.name: priority
table:columns.description: Dispatch priority. 1 is the most urgent. Priority 9 is the largest group at 69,639 rows and covers routine and administrative calls.

table:columns.name: how_received
table:columns.description: Code for how the call reached dispatch. `how_received_d` is the readable form.

table:columns.name: how_received_d
table:columns.description: How the call reached dispatch: by telephone, through the 911 system, or on view, meaning an officer observed it directly.

table:columns.name: cleared_by
table:columns.description: Code for how the call was closed.

table:columns.name: cleared_by_d
table:columns.description: How the call was closed.

table:columns.name: final_case_type
table:columns.description: Final call-type code after the officer cleared the call.

table:columns.name: final_case_type_d
table:columns.description: Call type after the officer cleared the call. This differs from the initial type whenever the reported problem was not what was found.

table:columns.name: agg_time_to_dispatch
table:columns.description: Elapsed seconds from receipt to dispatch.

table:columns.name: agg_travel_time
table:columns.description: Elapsed seconds from dispatch to arrival.

table:columns.name: agg_response_time
table:columns.description: Elapsed seconds from receipt to arrival. Negative values occur in the source data and should be filtered before use.

table:columns.name: agg_time_on_scene
table:columns.description: Elapsed seconds on scene.

table:columns.name: agg_service_time
table:columns.description: Elapsed seconds from receipt to the unit clearing.

table:columns.name: report_year
table:columns.description: Year the call was reported, as carried by the records system.

table:columns.name: year
table:columns.description: Year of the call.

table:columns.name: month
table:columns.description: Month of the call as a number.

table:columns.name: hour
table:columns.description: Hour of the call, 0 to 23.

table:columns.name: agg_time_to_dispatch_minutes
table:columns.description: Time to dispatch, in minutes.

table:columns.name: agg_travel_time_minutes
table:columns.description: Travel time in minutes.

table:columns.name: agg_response_time_minutes
table:columns.description: Response time in minutes, the same measure as `agg_response_time` divided by sixty.

table:columns.name: agg_service_time_minutes
table:columns.description: Total service time, in minutes.

table:columns.name: received_date_text
table:columns.description: Receipt timestamp as text, kept from the export.

table:columns.name: dispatch_date_text
table:columns.description: Dispatch timestamp as text.

table:columns.name: enroute_date_text
table:columns.description: En-route timestamp as text.

table:columns.name: at_scene_date_text
table:columns.description: Arrival timestamp as text.

table:columns.name: clear_date_text
table:columns.description: Clear timestamp as text.

table:columns.name: clear_date_text2
table:columns.description: Second clear timestamp as text, kept from the export.

table:columns.name: ORIG_FID
table:columns.description: Row identifier from the table this layer was built from.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
